description: DERIVABLE: Δ((5,1)) = [Z×F_p + N×F_n - F_D] / (y·χ((5,1))) where F_K = Habiro rational function evaluated at q₀. B = m_e × |target| = m_e × 4.353 = 2.224 MeV (matches AME to 0.01%). The binding is NOT an additional input — it is the DIFFERENCE of constituent Habiro evaluations. Per-knot = per Habiro polynomial.

data.per_knot_via: Habiro rational function p(u)/d(u) with integer coefficients
